title: Portal 2

upstream_assets.purpose: Audit only; candidate uses guarded final copy.
Audit only; candidate uses guarded final copy.

blockers: Native Windows install/uninstall and Hebrew gameplay/font rendering have not been tested. Do not enable or publish this candidate.

Upstream system-wide font substitution was replaced experimentally with four game-local Tahoma -> Courier New references inside update/pak01_dir.vpk. Additional engine-hardcoded font requests may exist; local substitution effectiveness remains unverified.
No native macOS implementation or validation. Linux archive remains reference material only.

installation.method: Experimental patch.windows.candidate.json via Kitor selective lifecycle; disabled from release discovery.
installation.uninstall: Restore only manifest affected originals; remove only patch-created files. No system registry effects.

conversion.selected_variant: GLADOS (first duplicate NSIS payload entries, matching source branch order)
conversion.strategy: NSIS VPatch output is subsequently overwritten by generic update/pak01_dir.vpk. Preserve its original-game MD5 guard, then directly install final bundled VPK with experimental local font edits. Converted intermediate BSDIFF retained for audit, not executed.
conversion.vpk_validation: All 19 original and rebuilt VPK entries pass CRC32 and length checks. Rebuilt VPK exact entry bytes match source except four intended font references.
conversion.system_mutations: None. Registry, font registration and native installer execution deliberately omitted.
